decided: 2026-10-03, Phase 289 plan 03, from the planning scan at HEAD d511f4c04
rule: A hit in a command that already allows AskUserQuestion is converted, never listed. An entry is only for a line that is not a menu: a prohibition, a pointer to the gate, a text floor. Matching is by file plus a substring of the hit line, so a line shift does not break an entry. An entry that matches no failing hit is stale and fails the fence.

entries.match: You may NOT render the gate as an ASCII box
entries.reason: A prohibition: the line forbids the typed-number ASCII menu and tells the model to fire the card instead.

entries.match: let the navigator choose to cross
entries.reason: Names the Decision Gate line that already renders through gate_render; it is a pointer to the gate, not a prose menu.
